required_findings.summary: Resolve requested candidate to immutable full commit once; use and retain resolved identity for all snapshots.
Hash actual Lean/Lake/Python binaries after execution and require equality, retaining both snapshots.
Generic explicit theorems in runtime executable modules must not be classified as reference instances.
Closed sibling scope variables leak into later source context; track active scope identities or omit/mark unresolved supplemental binder context.
Validate restricted local import grammar on comment-masked sources; reject unsupported local imports or capture all local import tokens. Label external cache trust/pins explicitly.

additional_limits: Private explicit mapping later keys only by user name, causing safe failure for valid same-user private helpers from different modules; fix map key or document current no-collision limitation.

Fresh Verify and driver import cached dependencies; official execution must be linked to root-authorized integrated build on same frozen source. This wrapper does not freshly elaborate imported modules.
Imported supplemental scope is inherited AxiomAudit definitions/opaque/axiom; inductive/constructor/recursor ConstantInfo kinds are not supplemental rows.
Counterexample category is fixture-family grouping, not count of logically negated theorem statements.
